answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and called out as primary-region-only, which is the closest match to the March latency degradation that recovered within minutes after a clean traffic shift. Rollback remains plausible given the 2h-old release, but that memory was an error spike, not latency, and a regional cutover still removes the only degraded write blast radius. Circuit breaking would shed settlement writes and violates the no-lost-write objective; replica routing previously fixed dashboard reads, not a write-heavy settlement peak; pre-peak headroom is not the same as reactive capacity mid-surge. Flagging settlement-write consistency risk on the cutover and leaving release vs load unresolved pending the b2 archive.
